description: Incident status update writer — Turn raw incident notes into a status page update: title, body, short social post, stage (investigating/identified/monitoring/resolved), impact, affected components and next-update time. For public audiences it strips IPs, internal hostnames, emails and secrets before and after the AI, and flags blame, speculation and unpromised fix times. text= required; optional stage=, impact=, service=, eta=, audience=public|internal, next_update_min=30. Example: /v1/ai/incident-update?text=API errors 30% since 14:05 UTC, db failover running Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
